name: PunchOut Rocket – CXML and OCI eProcurement integration
author: weblinksrl

sections.description:
PunchOut Rocket enables seamless integration between your WooCommerce store and enterprise procurement systems. Support for major procurement platforms including SAP Ariba, Coupa, Oracle, and any cXML-compatible system.

Features

  • cXML protocol support
  • Session-based punchout authentication
  • Automatic cart synchronization
  • Support for multiple procurement systems
  • Secure user mapping

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • WooCommerce 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • SSL certificate (HTTPS required)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/punchout-rocket/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > PunchOut to configure
  4. Configure your procurement system credentials
  5. Test the connection with your procurement platform

  • Session-based authentication
  • Cart synchronization
  • Multi-system support
